::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Nehemiah recounts the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls and the spiritual renewal of God's people. The book teaches that prayerful leadership and faithful obedience accomplish God's work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Nehemiah 1:4
I sat down and wept
### Why This Verse Nehemiah's burden begins ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Nehemiah's grief and prayer concerning Jerusalem's condition. The key verse demonstrates how godly leadership begins with prayer and burden for God's people. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Nehemiah 2:18
Let us rise up and build
### Why This Verse Vision casting and leadership ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Nehemiah's commission by the king and arrival in Jerusalem. The key verse highlights God's favor in opening doors for His work. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Nehemiah 3:5
Their nobles put not their necks to the work
### Why This Verse Memorable note on unwillingness ### Chapter Insight This chapter lists those rebuilding Jerusalem's walls. The key verse emphasizes unity and shared responsibility in accomplishing God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Nehemiah 4:14
Be not afraid of them
### Why This Verse Encouragement during opposition ### Chapter Insight This chapter records opposition to the rebuilding effort. The key verse demonstrates perseverance through prayer and vigilance amid opposition. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Nehemiah 5:19
Remember me, O my God, for good
### Why This Verse Nehemiah's recurring prayer ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses injustice among God's people. The key verse emphasizes compassion and integrity within the covenant community. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Nehemiah 6:3
I am doing a great work
### Why This Verse One of Nehemiah's most quoted verses ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts attempts to stop Nehemiah through intimidation and deception. The key verse highlights steadfast commitment to God's calling. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Nehemiah 7:2
He was a faithful man and feared God
### Why This Verse Leadership qualification ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the completion of the wall and the registration of the people. The key verse emphasizes faithful stewardship and organization. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Nehemiah 8:10
The joy of the LORD is your strength
### Why This Verse Most famous verse in Nehemiah ### Chapter Insight This chapter describes the public reading of God's Law. The key verse reveals the transforming power of God's Word and the joy found in Him. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Nehemiah 9:17
Thou art a God ready to pardon
### Why This Verse Great prayer of confession ### Chapter Insight This chapter records Israel's confession and review of God's faithfulness. The key verse highlights God's mercy despite repeated human failure. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Nehemiah 10:39
We will not forsake the house of our God
### Why This Verse Covenant commitment ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains the people's covenant commitment. The key verse emphasizes renewed dedication to obey God's commands. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Nehemiah 11:2
The people blessed the volunteers
### Why This Verse Sacrificial service ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the repopulation of Jerusalem. The key verse demonstrates willingness to sacrifice personal comfort for God's purposes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Nehemiah 12:43
The joy of Jerusalem was heard afar off
### Why This Verse Dedication celebration ### Chapter Insight This chapter celebrates the dedication of Jerusalem's wall. The key verse highlights joyful worship in response to God's faithfulness. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Nehemiah 13:31
Remember me, O my God, for good
### Why This Verse Closing prayer ### Chapter Insight This chapter recounts Nehemiah's final reforms. The key verse emphasizes the ongoing need for spiritual vigilance and obedience. :::
